opportunities.name: United flight search (origin/destination/dates/passengers/cabin)
opportunities.description: Search United flights from {origin} to {destination} for {dates}, with {passenger count}, {cabin} and optional {book with miles / one-way} options, then review or select a fare.
steps: Open the united.com booking widget (Flight tab)
Optionally toggle 'Book with miles' or trip type (roundtrip/one-way)
Type the departure city/airport and pick the suggestion
Type the destination city/airport and pick the suggestion
Open the Depart date picker, go to the right month, pick the departure date and return date
Optionally open travelers and adjust the adult/child counts
Optionally change the cabin class (e.g. Premium economy)
Click 'Find flights'
Optionally change the date on the results page, then select a fare or open Details/Seats

instances.values: Book with miles; Sacramento (SMF) → Houston (IAH); date picked from the 20.9k-miles fare calendar
Baltimore (BWI) → New York (NYC all airports); Aug 2–Aug 7, 2023; adult count reduced
Pune (PNQ) → New York (NYC); default dates; selected the $2,984 Economy roundtrip fare
Mumbai (BOM) → London (LON); Jul 1–Jul 5, 2023; adult and child counts adjusted; Premium economy
Springfield (SPI) → Austin (AUS); trip option toggled; date changed to Apr 29, 2023; viewed Details/Seats
Santa Fe (SAF) → Phoenix (PHX); next month, 13th–28th; selected the $681 United Economy roundtrip fare

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor restaurant search by location and filter
opportunities.description: Find restaurants on TripAdvisor in {location}, filtered by {cuisine/feature filter}.
steps: Click 'Restaurants'
Type the location in the search box and pick the matching suggestion
Optionally click 'More restaurants in …' and/or 'Show more' to expand the filters
Check the filter label (cuisine, dietary or feature)
Click 'Apply' if shown

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: Find parking on SpotHero near {venue} for {event} on {date}, with optional {time window}, {amenity filter} and {sort order}, and optionally book a spot.
steps: Type the venue in 'Search for parking' and pick the suggestion
Optionally open 'Select Event Date' and pick the date
Click the event
Optionally click Filter, check the amenity (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible) and click 'Show N Results'
Optionally set the sort order (Distance/Price)
Optionally set the Start Time and End Time, then click 'Update Search'
Optionally click 'Book Now' on a spot

instances.values: Barclays Center; Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets; sort by Distance; 3:00–5:00 PM; Book Now
Busch Stadium; Pittsburgh Pirates at St. Louis Cardinals; Wheelchair Accessible; sort by Price
Barclays Center; Apr 9, 2023; Philadelphia 76ers at Brooklyn Nets; Wheelchair Accessible; start 10:00 AM

opportunities.name: United map search from an origin
opportunities.description: Use United's map search to explore destinations from {origin}, with optional {trip type} and flexible dates.
steps: Open BOOK > 'Map search'
Type the 'Flying from' city and pick the airport
Optionally set the search type (e.g. Roundtrip) and turn on Flexible dates
Click 'Search'
Open a result / date range from the list of results

instances.values: Phoenix (PHX); opened the results list and picked Tue, Apr 25–Tue, May 2
